</script><script>
(function(){
  const nav=document.querySelector('.nav');
  const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu a[href^="#"]')];
  const internal=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]')];
  function goTo(hash){
    if(!hash || hash==='#'){ window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'}); return; }
    const target=document.querySelector(hash);
    if(target) target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
  }
  internal.forEach(link=>link.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    const hash=this.getAttribute('href');
    if(!hash) return;
    const target=hash==='#' ? document.documentElement : document.querySelector(hash);
    if(!target) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    goTo(hash);
    if(hash!=='#') history.replaceState(null,'',hash);
    links.forEach(link=>link.classList.toggle('active',link.getAttribute('href')===hash));
  }));
  function updateNav(){
    if(nav) nav.classList.toggle('nav-scrolled',window.scrollY>48);
    let current='';
    let bestTop=-1;
    links.forEach(link=>{
      const section=document.querySelector(link.getAttribute('href'));
      if(section && section.getBoundingClientRect().top<=150 && section.offsetTop>bestTop){
        bestTop=section.offsetTop;
        current=link.getAttribute('href');
      }
    });
    links.forEach(link=>link.classList.toggle('active',link.getAttribute('href')===current));
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll',updateNav,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('load',()=>{ if(location.hash) setTimeout(()=>goTo(location.hash),80); updateNav(); });
  updateNav();
})();
</script><script>
(function(){
  function processVisuals(){
    const steps=[...document.querySelectorAll('.process .step')];
    if(!steps.length || steps.some(step=>step.querySelector('.step-photo'))) return;
    const sources=[
      '[EMBEDDED_IMAGE]',
      '[EMBEDDED_IMAGE]',
      '[EMBEDDED_IMAGE]',
      '[EMBEDDED_IMAGE]'
    ];
    const positions=['center center','center center','center center','center center'];
    steps.forEach((step,index)=>{
      const photo=document.createElement('span');
      photo.className='step-photo';
      photo.setAttribute('role','img');
      photo.setAttribute('aria-label',['Şantiyede ölçü ve keşif','İç mekan tasarımı çalışması','Özel mobilya atölyesinde üretim','Mobilya montajı ve uygulama'][index]);
      photo.style.backgroundImage='url("'+sources[index]+'")';
      photo.style.backgroundPosition=positions[index];
      step.prepend(photo);
    });
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',processVisuals); else processVisuals();
})();
</script></body></html>
